body:
I was gloriously saved when I was 19 years old while attending Eastern Kentucky University.  I had been living a miserable life, but when I realized I was a sinner and needed forgiveness and a relationship with Jesus, He forgave my sins, came into my life, and gave my life meaning!

God also blessed me with a beautiful, godly woman while attending college.  Lisa and I were married in 1988 and began a wonderful life together serving the Lord!  We have lived in Johnson County Kentucky since 1993, where we raised 5 children.  They are grown now and the oldest 4 have begun their own families.  So far we have 7 grandchildren who call us "Papaw and Mamaw"!

When I was 5 years into my Christian walk, God called me to preach His Gospel, and I found myself proclaiming His Word beginning in 1992.  I was originally ordained in the Free Will Baptist denomination in 1995.  I have served Him through the years in various churches in Lawrence and Johnson counties as a lay minister, youth leader, assistant pastor, pastor, and filling in as pulpit supply as needed.

I enjoyed a long and successful career as a special education teacher with the Johnson County school system.  I am retired now from that occupation which allows me to focus more on ministry and serving as the current pastor of Flat Gap Baptist Church.  I feel very privileged and blessed to be here amongst such wonderful folk, as we serve the Lord together!

We would all be honored to have you come be with us at Flat Gap Baptist any time the doors are open.  Hope to see you soon!
